headline: Panpanta Build
title: Panpanta Best Build | Water Cannon and Hydro Roll | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Panpanta is a Water Breaker, so Break is the stat to stack. Water Cannon lobs a water ball that leaves a puddle, and Hydro Roll rams enemies and, near water, raises your Break efficiency. Its Appeal trait adds more Break if you bring an opposite gender Susuta family member. Hold a Gargantuan Horn. Do you run Panpanta? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Panpanta is a Water Breaker. Run Water Cannon and Hydro Roll, bring an opposite gender Susuta family member for the Appeal trait and hold a Gargantuan Horn.
